name: Dark Stars v0.2 - 990 yr binary
notes: The original wide, inclined architecture. a_wd solved from the 990 yr target: a = (P^2 M)^(1/3) = 112.4293 AU. KNOWN PROBLEM: at 75 deg the gas giant is itself Kozai-unstable on a ~2e4 yr timescale and nothing suppresses it. Once its eccentricity grows, its periastron crosses the blue planet and the planet is scattered. Kept for reference and comparison, not as a long-term-stable system.
